rationale: Structure is an ODE system (explicit RHS, no ungoverned function calls, no integral kernels, no derivatives inside the RHS besides the state-derivative definitions supplied by the contract). Roles inherit the contract exactly: t is the single independent variable, theta/omega/wake_drag_angular_acceleration are the three states, omega is the benchmark target state and its RHS is the benchmark output. All ten listed parameters are fixed at physically reasonable values: gravity=9.81, link_length=1 m, link_to_bob_mass_ratio=0.1 (light link), bob_radius=0.05 m (thin bob), linear_drag_rate=0.05, quadratic_drag_factor=0.05, aerodynamic_drag_relaxation_time=0.2 s, pivot_coulomb_friction_angular_acceleration=0.05, pivot_friction_transition_angular_speed=0.1 rad/s, and pivot_bearing_load_friction_angular_acceleration=0.05 (well inside the suggested [g/(10000 L), g/(100 L)] window). Sampling t in [0,20] s at 400 points spans ~10 natural periods (natural omega ~ sqrt(g_eff/L) ~ 3.1 rad/s) so that friction envelopes have time to differentiate the child from the parent. Excitation check (full-system child-vs-parent on omega) gives the new bearing-load term 8.1*sigma visibility at sigma=0.05, well above the k=5 threshold.
